Scene.ElementCountExceeded.en: The number of elements exceeds the limit.

Scene.BackgroundMustBeImage.en: The background must be an image.

Recovery.MissingLiveCanvas.zh: 恢复状态缺少实时画布。
Recovery.MissingLiveCanvas.en: The recovery state is missing the live canvas.

Recovery.InvalidLiveDocumentKind.en: The live canvas type is invalid.

Recovery.InvalidCaptureDocumentKind.en: The screenshot draft type is invalid.

Scene.InvalidElementId.en: An element ID is invalid or duplicated.

Scene.InvalidArrowHead.zh: 箭头头部样式或尺寸无效。
Scene.InvalidArrowHead.en: The arrowhead style or size is invalid.

Scene.InvalidImageCrop.en: The image crop bounds are invalid.

Scene.EffectsRequireImage.zh: 只有图片可以使用局部效果。
Scene.EffectsRequireImage.en: Only images can have local effects.

Scene.InvalidRenderedBounds.en: The rendered element bounds are invalid.

Export.EmptyRegion.en: The export area cannot be empty.

Export.BufferTooLarge.zh: 导出尺寸过大，无法建立图像缓冲。
Export.BufferTooLarge.en: The export dimensions are too large to create an image buffer.

Images.EffectBufferFailed.zh: 无法建立图片效果缓冲。
Images.EffectBufferFailed.en: The image effect buffer could not be created.

Recovery.BothFilesUnreadable.zh: 当前恢复文件和前代恢复文件都无法读取。原文件已保留。
Recovery.BothFilesUnreadable.en: Neither the current nor the previous recovery file could be read. The original files have been preserved.

Recovery.NoValidPreviousFile.zh: 恢复文件无法读取，且没有有效前代。原文件已保留。
Recovery.NoValidPreviousFile.en: The recovery file could not be read and no valid previous file is available. The original file has been preserved.

Capture.EmptyRegion.en: The screenshot area cannot be empty.

Overlay.RasterTargetUnreadable.en: The overlay raster target is not readable.

Overlay.CacheAllocationFailed.zh: 无法分配浮层场景缓存。
Overlay.CacheAllocationFailed.en: The overlay scene cache could not be allocated.

Project.IncompleteAssets.zh: 工程引用的图片资源不完整。
Project.IncompleteAssets.en: The image assets referenced by the project are incomplete.

Project.AssetCapacityExceeded.zh: 工程图片资源超出文件格式容量限制。
Project.AssetCapacityExceeded.en: The project image assets exceed the file format capacity limits.

Project.InvalidAssetMediaType.en: The image asset media type is invalid.

Project.PackageTooLarge.en: The project file is too large.

Project.InvalidArchiveEntries.zh: 压缩包包含重复或过多条目。
Project.InvalidArchiveEntries.en: The archive contains duplicate entries or too many entries.

Project.ExpandedCapacityExceeded.zh: 工程解压后超过容量限制。
Project.ExpandedCapacityExceeded.en: The expanded project exceeds the capacity limit.

Project.UnexpectedFormat.zh: 文件不是预期的浮绘工程类型。
Project.UnexpectedFormat.en: The file is not the expected FloatCanvas project type.

Project.InvalidAssetManifest.en: The project asset manifest is invalid.

Project.UnexpectedArchiveContents.zh: 工程包含未声明或缺失的条目。
Project.UnexpectedArchiveContents.en: The project contains undeclared entries or is missing declared entries.

Project.AssetReferencesMismatch.zh: 工程的图片引用与清单不一致。
Project.AssetReferencesMismatch.en: The project image references do not match the manifest.

Project.AssetLengthMismatch.en: The image asset length does not match.

Project.AssetHashMismatch.zh: 图片资源 SHA256 校验失败。
Project.AssetHashMismatch.en: The image asset SHA256 check failed.

Project.InvalidJson.zh: 工程 JSON 格式无效。

Project.DataOutOfRange.zh: 工程数据超出支持范围。
Project.DataOutOfRange.en: The project data is outside the supported range.

Project.InvalidContentType.en: The project content type is invalid.

Project.JsonTooLarge.zh: 工程 JSON 超过大小限制。
Project.JsonTooLarge.en: The project JSON exceeds the size limit.

Recovery.MissingRequiredFields.zh: 恢复状态缺少必要字段。
Recovery.MissingRequiredFields.en: The recovery state is missing required fields.

Scene.MissingRequiredFields.en: The scene is missing required fields.

Project.DuplicateJsonFields.zh: 工程 JSON 包含重复字段。
Project.DuplicateJsonFields.en: The project JSON contains duplicate fields.

Project.InvalidEntryLength.en: The archive entry length is invalid.

Geometry.NonInvertibleTransform.en: The transform matrix is not invertible.

Images.ImportEncodingFailed.en: The imported image could not be encoded.

Images.UnsupportedOrCorrupt.zh: 图片格式不受支持或文件已损坏。
Images.UnsupportedOrCorrupt.en: The image format is unsupported or the file is corrupted.

Images.BufferTooLarge.zh: 图片尺寸过大，无法分配缓冲。
Images.BufferTooLarge.en: The image dimensions are too large to allocate a buffer.

History.TransactionAlreadyActive.zh: 已有未完成的编辑操作。
History.TransactionAlreadyActive.en: An editing operation is already in progress.

History.NoActiveTransaction.zh: 没有进行中的编辑操作。
History.NoActiveTransaction.en: No editing operation is in progress.

Keyboard.ExitEditingBeforeConfigure.zh: 请先退出编辑，再设置键盘接管。
Keyboard.ExitEditingBeforeConfigure.en: Exit editing before configuring keyboard input ownership.

Keyboard.IsolationAlreadyEnabled.en: Keyboard input ownership is already enabled.

Keyboard.MonitorStartFailed.zh: 无法启动输入状态监测。
Keyboard.MonitorStartFailed.en: Input state monitoring could not be started.

Keyboard.LocalStateInitializationFailed.zh: 无法初始化浮绘的本地键盘状态。
Keyboard.LocalStateInitializationFailed.en: FloatCanvas could not initialize its local keyboard state.

Hotkeys.DuplicateBindings.zh: 切换与隐藏快捷键不能相同。
Hotkeys.DuplicateBindings.en: The toggle and hide shortcuts must be different.

Hotkeys.WindowsKeyReserved.zh: Win 键保留给系统，请使用 Ctrl、Alt 或 Shift 组合。
Hotkeys.WindowsKeyReserved.en: The Windows key is reserved for the system. Use Ctrl, Alt or Shift combinations instead.

Hotkeys.EmergencyReleaseReserved.zh: Ctrl+Alt+Esc 是紧急释放组合，不能设为切换或隐藏快捷键。
Hotkeys.EmergencyReleaseReserved.en: Ctrl+Alt+Esc is the emergency release shortcut and cannot be assigned to toggle or hide.

Hotkeys.SystemExitReserved.zh: 该组合保留给系统离开编辑模式。
Hotkeys.SystemExitReserved.en: This combination is reserved for leaving editing through the system.

Overlay.RenderBufferFailed.zh: 无法建立浮绘渲染缓冲。
Overlay.RenderBufferFailed.en: The FloatCanvas rendering buffer could not be created.

Overlay.DisplayUpdateFailed.en: The FloatCanvas display could not be updated.

Capture.ExclusionStateReadFailed.zh: 无法读取窗口的截图排除状态。
Capture.ExclusionStateReadFailed.en: The window capture exclusion state could not be read.

Capture.ExclusionFailed.zh: 无法临时排除浮绘窗口，截图已取消。
Capture.ExclusionFailed.en: FloatCanvas windows could not be temporarily excluded. The screenshot was cancelled.

Capture.RestoreRequiresUiThread.zh: 截图窗口状态必须在原 UI 线程恢复。
Capture.RestoreRequiresUiThread.en: Capture window state must be restored on the original UI thread.

Capture.ExclusionStateRestoreFailed.zh: 无法恢复窗口截图状态。
Capture.ExclusionStateRestoreFailed.en: The window capture state could not be restored.

Capture.WindowOrderRestoreFailed.zh: 无法恢复截图前的浮绘窗口顺序。
Capture.WindowOrderRestoreFailed.en: The FloatCanvas window order from before the screenshot could not be restored.

Capture.WindowRestoreErrors.zh: 截图后恢复浮绘窗口时发生错误。
Capture.WindowRestoreErrors.en: Errors occurred while restoring FloatCanvas windows after the screenshot.

Overlay.PlatformUnsupported.zh: 浮绘需要 Windows 10 1607（内部版本 14393）或更新版本。
Overlay.PlatformUnsupported.en: FloatCanvas requires Windows 10 version 1607 (build 14393) or later.

Overlay.DpiContextFailed.zh: 无法启用屏幕物理像素坐标，浮绘已取消当前窗口操作。
Overlay.DpiContextFailed.en: Physical screen pixel coordinates could not be enabled. The window operation was cancelled.

Overlay.DpiContextRestoreFailed.zh: 无法恢复窗口的 DPI 坐标上下文。
Overlay.DpiContextRestoreFailed.en: The window DPI awareness context could not be restored.

Capture.LiveExclusionUnsupported.zh: 实时桌面马赛克需要 Windows 10 2004 或更新版本；当前系统可使用静态截图效果。
Capture.LiveExclusionUnsupported.en: Live desktop pixelation requires Windows 10 version 2004 or later. Static screenshot effects are available on this system.

Overlay.FocusMonitorFailed.zh: 无法监测编辑输入焦点，浮绘未接管输入。
Overlay.FocusMonitorFailed.en: Editing input focus could not be monitored. FloatCanvas has not taken ownership of input.

Hotkeys.BindingsMustDiffer.zh: 切换和隐藏快捷键必须不同。
Hotkeys.BindingsMustDiffer.en: The toggle and hide shortcuts must be different.

Hotkeys.ConflictAndRestoreFailed.zh: 快捷键冲突，且原快捷键被其他程序占用；请通过托盘重新设置快捷键。
Hotkeys.ConflictAndRestoreFailed.en: The new shortcuts conflict and the previous shortcuts have been claimed by another application. Set the shortcuts again through the tray icon.

Hotkeys.ConflictPreviousPreserved.zh: 快捷键已被占用；原快捷键保持有效。
Hotkeys.ConflictPreviousPreserved.en: The shortcut is already in use. The previous shortcuts remain active.

Overlay.FocusAcquisitionFailed.zh: 无法取得键盘焦点，仍处于穿透模式。请点击浮绘托盘图标后重试。
Overlay.FocusAcquisitionFailed.en: Keyboard focus could not be acquired. FloatCanvas remains in pass-through mode. Click its tray icon and try again.

Overlay.InputAcquisitionFailed.zh: 输入接管未能启动，仍处于穿透模式。{0}
Overlay.InputAcquisitionFailed.en: Input ownership could not be started. FloatCanvas remains in pass-through mode. {0}

Capture.AlreadyInProgress.zh: 已有截图操作正在进行。
Capture.AlreadyInProgress.en: A screenshot operation is already in progress.

Overlay.RequiresCreatorUiThread.zh: OverlayHost 必须在创建它的 UI 线程上使用。
Overlay.RequiresCreatorUiThread.en: OverlayHost must be used on the UI thread that created it.

Hotkeys.InvalidBinding.zh: 快捷键需要有效按键及 Alt、Ctrl、Shift 或 Win 修饰键。
Hotkeys.InvalidBinding.en: A shortcut requires a valid key and an Alt, Ctrl, Shift or Windows modifier.

Overlay.DisplayLayoutReadFailed.en: The display layout could not be read.

Overlay.WindowCreationFailed.en: A FloatCanvas window could not be created.

Capture.AtLeastOneMonitorRequired.en: At least one display is required.

Capture.InvalidDisplayLayout.zh: 显示器布局无效或存在重复屏幕。
Capture.InvalidDisplayLayout.en: The display layout is invalid or contains duplicate displays.

Capture.DesktopCaptureAlreadyActive.zh: 已有桌面捕获正在进行。
Capture.DesktopCaptureAlreadyActive.en: A desktop capture is already in progress.

Capture.DesktopTooLarge.zh: 桌面区域过大，无法创建截图。
Capture.DesktopTooLarge.en: The desktop area is too large to create a screenshot.

Capture.BufferCreationFailed.en: The screenshot buffer could not be created.

Capture.DisplayLayoutChanged.zh: 捕获时显示器布局发生变化，请重试截图。
Capture.DisplayLayoutChanged.en: The display layout changed during capture. Try taking the screenshot again.

Capture.UnmatchedDxgiOutputs.zh: 无法匹配显示器的 DXGI 输出：{0}。请检查显示连接后重试。
Capture.UnmatchedDxgiOutputs.en: The DXGI outputs for these displays could not be matched: {0}. Check the display connections and try again.

Capture.EncodingFailed.en: The screenshot could not be encoded.

Capture.ConnectionReset.zh: 桌面捕获连接已重置，可能发生了锁屏或显示模式变化，请重试。
Capture.ConnectionReset.en: The desktop capture connection was reset, possibly because the screen was locked or the display mode changed. Try again.

Capture.UnsupportedPixelFormat.zh: 首版截图支持 SDR BGRA 输出，当前像素格式为 {0}。
Capture.UnsupportedPixelFormat.en: This version supports SDR BGRA capture output. The current pixel format is {0}.

Capture.FreshFrameTimedOut.zh: {0} 未在 3 秒内提供截图操作之后的新桌面帧，请重试。
Capture.FreshFrameTimedOut.en: {0} did not provide a new desktop frame within 3 seconds after the capture request. Try again.

Capture.RotationOrResolutionChanged.zh: 屏幕旋转或分辨率在截图期间发生变化，请重试。
Capture.RotationOrResolutionChanged.en: The display rotation or resolution changed during capture. Try again.

Keyboard.PrivateMessageRequired.zh: 请使用私有 WM_APP 消息。

Keyboard.ForegroundRequired.zh: 请先切换到浮绘，再进入绘图模式。
Keyboard.ForegroundRequired.en: Switch to FloatCanvas before entering drawing mode.

Keyboard.UiNotificationFailed.zh: 键盘输入接管无法通知界面。
Keyboard.UiNotificationFailed.en: Keyboard input ownership could not notify its UI.

Keyboard.HookInstallationFailed.zh: 无法安装私有键盘钩子。
Keyboard.HookInstallationFailed.en: The private keyboard hook could not be installed.

Keyboard.WatchdogStartFailed.zh: 无法启动键盘状态监测。
Keyboard.WatchdogStartFailed.en: The keyboard watchdog could not start.

Keyboard.OwnNotificationWindowRequired.zh: 通知窗口必须属于当前进程。
Keyboard.OwnNotificationWindowRequired.en: The notification HWND must belong to this process.

Keyboard.InvalidStateLength.zh: 需要 256 字节的键盘状态。
